breaking_news.headline: How much of an economic boom is the 2026 FIFA World Cup for the U.S. hosting cities?
breaking_news.summary: The FIFA World Cup is thought to bring an economic windfall to the cities and regions where games will be played during four weeks this summer. How true is that?

breaking_news.headline: Visa and OpenAI integrate Visa's secure global payment directly into ChatGPT
breaking_news.summary: Would you hand an AI chatbot your credit card? This week, Visa's deal with ChatGPT maker OpenAI became the latest step in the march toward a future where AI offers to shop on your behalf.

breaking_news.headline: Is it a renter's market? It depends on where you live
breaking_news.summary: About 40% of rentals on Zillow offer move-in deals, like a month of free rent, thanks to a construction boom that created an apartment surplus in some parts of the United States.

breaking_news.headline: Survey confirms the struggle of working parents: 'No way to be two things at once'
breaking_news.summary: A new Pew survey finds many working parents feel they cannot give 100% at either work or home. Benefits like paid sick leave and more affordable childcare could help.

breaking_news.headline: The war with Iran is making oil changes pricier. And a deal won't solve it
breaking_news.summary: The U.S. may be the world's biggest producer of crude oil, but that's not the case for motor oil. The cost of lubricants is soaring, and even a tentative deal to end the war won't solve the problem.

breaking_news.headline: Shipping exec says industry needs assurances Strait of Hormuz will be safe
breaking_news.summary: NPR's Ailsa Chang talks with Jakob Larsen, chief safety and security officer at BIMCO, the global shipping association, about what it might mean to reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

breaking_news.headline: 3 things to know about the new Fed chief's first meeting
breaking_news.summary: Kevin Warsh takes questions from reporters for the first time since taking over as Chairman of the Federal Reserve.  Warsh and his colleagues are expected to hold interest rates steady today.

breaking_news.headline: With Iran deal, Trump told ships to 'start your engines.' That's not happening yet
breaking_news.summary: Iran's control of the Strait of Hormuz inflicted global pain during the months-long conflict with the U.S. and Israel. A tentative deal is in place, but questions remain about the key waterway.

breaking_news.headline: Bolivia signs $20m deal with US to fight drug trafficking, foreign ministry says
breaking_news.summary: Under its new president, Bolivia is re-establishing severed ties with the US to combat organised crime.

breaking_news.headline: Australian shock jock wins A$12m payout after radio station tore up contract
breaking_news.summary: Kyle Sandilands was sacked after an on-air spat with his co-host, who accused him of bullying.

breaking_news.headline: Norway's crown princess undergoes successful lung transplant, palace says
breaking_news.summary: Crown Princess Mette-Marit, who suffered from pulmonary fibrosis, will now spend several weeks recovering in hospital.

breaking_news.headline: Brazil convicts Jair Bolsonaro's son of pursuing US help in father's legal battle
breaking_news.summary: Eduardo Bolsonaro called the conviction "baseless and senseless".

breaking_news.headline: Search for six-year-old Ebola patient after armed men storm DR Congo hospital
breaking_news.summary: Health facilities have come under attack during the current outbreak as a result of misinformation and fear.

breaking_news.headline: 'They came with machetes' - deadline looms for migrants to leave South Africa
breaking_news.summary: Protesters have set 30 June as the date for all undocumented migrants to leave the country.

breaking_news.headline: Status quo at Jerusalem's holiest site under threat as Israeli nationalists flout rules
breaking_news.summary: Israeli nationalists are increasingly flouting a convention on how faiths share the al-Aqsa mosque compound.

breaking_news.headline: Israel launches fresh strikes on Lebanon despite Trump criticism
breaking_news.summary: Speaking on Tuesday, Trump said Israel's PM Benjamin Netanyahu needed "to be more responsible with respect to Lebanon".

breaking_news.headline: Thames Water moves step closer to nationalisation after government objects to rescue deal
breaking_news.summary: The environment secretary says the deal does not do enough for consumers or the environment.

breaking_news.headline: Musk's SpaceX overtakes Amazon to become world's fifth most valuable firm
breaking_news.summary: Elon Musk's rocket firm has overtaken the retail and media empire in value after a surge in its share price.

breaking_news.headline: Struggling Pizza Hut chain to be sold for $2.7bn
breaking_news.summary: The decision comes after a prolonged period of difficulty for the chain, which has faced increasing competition from a range of rivals.

breaking_news.headline: What is Helium-3 and could we get it from the moon?
breaking_news.summary: Helium-3 is expensive and demand is forecast to soar, so some are planning to mine it on the moon.
